text: Part one. The tourist praises everything. The view from the plane: neat fields, coloured houses, an age old peace. The East, he says, has only ever given to the West, religion, art, civilisation, without any idea of ownership. He knows the history from books: the valley as a lake, Manjushri's sword, the monks' pure samyak gaze.
